Okay, confession time. This weekend I watched nine episodes. Nine, in two days. I did hardly any homework, basically none, and now I have a test on Tuesday and I am not ready. My screen time said eleven hours on Saturday. Eleven hours! That is not even possible, and yet, here we are. So here is my rule for next weekend, and I am saying it out loud so somebody holds me to it: two episodes a day, maximum, and homework first. Two. Not nine.

Good afternoon, everyone. We have some news about homework. More than a hundred students told us there is simply too much of it, and after looking at the numbers, we agree. So, from next week, there is a limit: one hour a night, and nothing at the weekend. Teachers have all been told. If you still find you have too much, please talk to your teacher, and be honest about how many hours it actually takes you. That is the only way we can fix the amount properly. Thank you.
